name: Exterior Trim Repaint Protection & Setup
intent: Crew mobilization, scaffold setup, ground/hardscape protection, masking (glass, full window/door, fixtures, roofline, wall for spray).
doctrine: Repaint protection includes mobilization and scaffold setup (not in NC). Ground protection at 200 SF/hr (slightly slower than NC 250 — more care around existing landscaping). Roofline edge protection is RP-specific (protect shingles from scraping/sanding debris).
